abstract: Audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings
system_message:
You are Harbor Safety and Navigation Authority (SAFE). The Harbor Safety and Navigation Authority (SAFE) audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings, as well as maintaining operational assessments of harbor safety tender capabilities across candidate marinas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits harbor facility security certification and emergency shoreline evacuation timings（PROT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-PROT-9ZR：For Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin, the harbor facility security zone certified status is true under active International Ship and Port Facility Security compliance across the racing paddock perimeter, and the maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration is 25 min to evacuate peak race village enclosures to municipal assembly areas.
SAFE-PROT-P3S：For Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal, the harbor facility security zone certified status is true under active port security certification, and the maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration is 18 min for the peak race village spectator enclosure.
SAFE-PROT-FL7：For Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor, the harbor facility security zone certified status is true for the restricted racing team perimeter, while the maximum shoreline evacuation egress duration is 32 min for full clearing to municipal assembly areas.

information_points.title: Punt tender firefighting（FIREF）
information_points.content:
SAFE-FIREF-C8U：For Oostende Royal Yacht Harbor, dedicated harbor tender foam monitors deliver a water cannon pumping rate of 1800 L/min.
SAFE-FIREF-UQN：For Esbjerg Outer Harbor Terminal, port response workboats provide a water cannon pumping rate of 3000 L/min maximum sustained discharge.
SAFE-FIREF-GZV：For Port of Ijmuiden Regatta Basin, harbor response workboats maintain a water cannon pumping rate of 2400 L/min maximum sustained discharge.
